posts.name: dpt
posts.cooked:
Referee:

Is there a way of getting it down the road, or am I out of luck?

I don’t know of any plans to reprint the playmat (and I don’t know if they printed any extras).

Referee:

Those SE and SW maps have gameplay maps on the back?

No, the back of the playmat is blank. Presumably if there is a 5-6p expansion one day it will come with standard gameplay maps on one side and those SE and SW maps on the back.

Referee:

Besides two maps and two more colors, is something else included?

With Champions of the Dahan? Backers got more copies of the pieces to play a 5-6p game (Invaders, Dahan, Fear, Energy), the thematic island playmat including the SE and SW boards, a poster map of Europe, and a signed box.
